title: Meeting Source MCP Sync Worker

scope.product_surface: Brainbase settings and Meeting Review Package ingest
scope.primary_user: Brainbase operator configuring meeting transcript sources
scope.outcome: Tactiq and Plaud.ai MCP transcript events are synchronized into Meeting Review Package review candidates without relying on Slack attachments as the primary transcript source.

steps.label: Configure Tactiq and Plaud.ai MCP sources
steps.user_intent: Set up provider status and credentials while keeping secret material redacted.
acceptance: Provider status can be inspected without exposing full credentials.
Tactiq and Plaud.ai can be enabled independently.
The UI exposes sync scope controls for organization, project, and optional case scope.

steps.label: Scheduled sync discovers source events
steps.user_intent: Let the cron worker find new online meetings from Tactiq and offline or fallback meetings from Plaud.ai.
acceptance: Each upstream event is converted into a normalized source_event.
Provider cursors advance after the ingest loop completes.
Duplicate events across providers collapse into a single canonical event when identity matches.

steps.label: Preview source events before ingest
steps.user_intent: Check which meeting events will be replayed or submitted before creating review workload.
acceptance: Manual preview returns normalized events with provider provenance.
Preview does not mutate workflow output unless explicitly confirmed.

steps.label: Confirm resync into Meeting Review Package
steps.user_intent: Submit selected source events into Meeting Pack so meeting notes, tasks, decisions, follow-up, and graph promotion candidates are generated.
acceptance: The ingest envelope includes org_id, project_id, meeting_identity, source_event, supporting_source_events, evidence_refs, and required output categories.
Missing organization or project blocks submit mode instead of creating unscoped workflow runs.
Draft-only mode remains available for non-mutating validation.

steps.label: Review generated Meeting Pack candidates
steps.user_intent: Approve or revise generated notes, tasks, decisions, follow-up drafts, and graph promotion candidates from Tactiq/Plaud source events.
acceptance: Human review remains the approval boundary for generated outputs.

non_goals: Building native Tactiq or Plaud.ai OAuth setup in this story.
Replacing Meeting Review Package generation logic.
Treating calendar events as mandatory source identity.

risk_controls.risk: Secrets leak through settings UI or API responses.
risk_controls.control: Provider credentials are displayed as redacted status only.

risk_controls.risk: Phone calls or ad hoc conversations have no calendar event.
risk_controls.control: source_event is canonical for this sync path; calendar linkage is optional enrichment only.

risk_controls.risk: Wrong project context causes poor Graph SSOT entity resolution.
risk_controls.control: Confirm submit requires explicit org/project scope and carries meeting_identity candidate scope into the ingest envelope.
